§6Oily Scraps§f

§aShred polluted dirt blocks, get grimy residue. It's your ticket to arsenic.§f

§bOily Scraps§f are obtained by shredding various polluted earth blocks found near oil deposits.

§6Sources§f (shredder):
§b• Cracked Stone, Oily Sand, Red Oily Sand§f
§b• Dead Dirt, Porous Stone, Oily Dirt§f

§6Key Use§f:
§b• §eArsenic Nugget§f, Ore Acidizer: 16 Oily Scraps + 100 mB High-Performance Solvent

§6Where to Find§f:
§b• Oil biomes§f generate these blocks naturally around bedrock oil deposits
§b• Shredding§f them in any shredder converts them to oily scraps
§b• Renewable§f as long as you keep finding oil-bearing terrain

§ePS:§f Arsenic shows up in alloys like Arsenic Bronze and in circuits later in progression. Stockpile these scraps while you're mining oil, you'll need them sooner than you think.
